---
title: "Overall survival by patient-level median TFx within receptor subgroups"
output: html_document
date: "2026-07-01"
---

# ============================================================
# Kaplan-Meier plots: Overall survival by patient-level median TFx
# within receptor subgroups
#
# Input file should contain:
#   patient_id
#   median_TFx
#   Overall_Survival_days
#   Event
#   Subgroups
#
# Subgroups:
#   HR+ HER2-
#   HR+ HER2+
#   HR- HER2-
#   HR- HER2+
#
# Analysis:
#   For each subgroup:
#     1. Keep patients with median_TFx >= 3%
#     2. Split patients by subgroup-specific median TFx
#     3. Plot OS KM curve: Low median TFx vs High median TFx
#     4. Save median OS months in summary table
# ============================================================
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

# ----------------------------
# Paths
# ----------------------------
survival_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/AURORA/Survival"

input_file <- file.path(
  survival_dir,
  "AURORA_all_patients_median_TFx_patientMedianGE3_OS_Event_clean.Earliest_Met_Diagnosis.csv"
)

out_dir <- file.path(
  survival_dir,
  "KM_median_TFx_by_subtype_patientMedianGE3",
  "Earliest_Met_Diagnosis"
)

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

summary_out <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "OS_KM_by_median_TFx_within_receptor_subgroups_summary.csv"
)

cat("Input file:\n", input_file, "\n\n")
cat("Output directory:\n", out_dir, "\n\n")

# ----------------------------
# Read data
# ----------------------------
df <- read_csv(input_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

cat("Rows in input:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Columns:\n")
print(colnames(df))

# ----------------------------
# Required columns
# ----------------------------
required_cols <- c(
  "patient_id",
  "Subtype",
  "median_TFx",
  "Overall_Survival_days",
  "Event"
)
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(df))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Missing required columns: ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
      "\nPlease make sure Subgroups is already present in AURORA_all_patients_median_TFx_OS_clean.csv."
    )
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# Helper functions
# ----------------------------
format_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) {
    return("p = NA")
  } else if (p < 0.001) {
    return("p < 0.001")
  } else {
    return(paste0("p = ", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)))
  }
}

safe_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_replace_all("\\+", "pos") %>%
    str_replace_all("-", "neg") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s+", "_") %>%
    str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "")
}

get_median_value <- function(median_tbl, group_name, value_col) {
  x <- median_tbl %>%
    filter(group_clean == group_name) %>%
    pull({{ value_col }})

  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  return(x[1])
}

# ----------------------------
# Clean and prepare data
# Keep only patients with available median_TFx >= 3%
# ----------------------------
days_per_month <- 365.25 / 12
min_median_TFx_cutoff <- 3

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    patient_id = as.character(patient_id),
    median_TFx = as.numeric(median_TFx),
    Overall_Survival_days = as.numeric(Overall_Survival_days),
    OS_months = Overall_Survival_days / days_per_month,
    Event = as.numeric(Event),

    # Use Subtype column from OS clean file
    receptor_subtype = str_squish(as.character(Subtype)),

    # Standardize HER2 capitalization
    receptor_subtype = str_replace_all(receptor_subtype, "Her2", "HER2"),
    receptor_subtype = str_replace_all(receptor_subtype, "her2", "HER2"),

    receptor_subtype = factor(
      receptor_subtype,
      levels = c("HR+ HER2-", "HR+ HER2+", "HR- HER2-", "HR- HER2+")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(patient_id),
    !is.na(median_TFx),
    median_TFx >= min_median_TFx_cutoff,
    !is.na(OS_months),
    OS_months > 0,
    !is.na(Event),
    !is.na(receptor_subtype)
  )

cat("\nApplied patient-level median_TFx cutoff: >= ",
    min_median_TFx_cutoff, "%\n", sep = "")

cat("Patients after median_TFx cutoff and usable OS/Event:", nrow(df), "\n")

cat("\nSubtype counts after filtering:\n")
print(table(df$receptor_subtype, useNA = "ifany"))

cat("\nSubtype deaths/events after filtering:\n")
print(table(df$receptor_subtype, df$Event, useNA = "ifany"))

# ----------------------------
# Save cleaned patient-level OS subgroup input
# ----------------------------
cleaned_out <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "OS_KM_by_median_TFx_within_receptor_subgroups_patient_input.csv"
)

df %>%
  select(
    patient_id,
    median_TFx,
    Overall_Survival_days,
    OS_months,
    Event,
    Subtype,
    receptor_subtype
  ) %>%
  write_csv(cleaned_out)

cat("\nSaved cleaned OS subgroup input:\n", cleaned_out, "\n")

# ----------------------------
# Loop through receptor subgroups
# ----------------------------
subtypes <- c("HR+ HER2-", "HR+ HER2+", "HR- HER2-", "HR- HER2+")

summary_list <- list()

for (subtype in subtypes) {

  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat("Running subtype:", subtype, "\n")
  cat("============================================================\n")

  sub_df <- df %>%
    filter(receptor_subtype == subtype) %>%
    droplevels()

  n_sub <- nrow(sub_df)
  n_events <- sum(sub_df$Event == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_censored <- sum(sub_df$Event == 0, na.rm = TRUE)

  cat("Patients:", n_sub, "\n")
  cat("Deaths/events:", n_events, "\n")
  cat("Censored:", n_censored, "\n")

  if (n_sub < 6) {
    cat("Skipping", subtype, ": too few patients.\n")

    summary_list[[subtype]] <- data.frame(
      receptor_subtype = subtype,
      status = "Skipped: too few patients",
      n_patients = n_sub,
      n_events_deaths = n_events,
      n_censored = n_censored,
      TFx_cutpoint = NA_real_,

      low_n = NA_integer_,
      low_events_deaths = NA_integer_,
      low_median_OS_months = NA_real_,
      low_median_OS_lower_95CI = NA_real_,
      low_median_OS_upper_95CI = NA_real_,

      high_n = NA_integer_,
      high_events_deaths = NA_integer_,
      high_median_OS_months = NA_real_,
      high_median_OS_lower_95CI = NA_real_,
      high_median_OS_upper_95CI = NA_real_,

      logrank_chi_square = NA_real_,
      logrank_p_value = NA_real_
    )

    next
  }

  # ----------------------------
  # Subgroup-specific median TFx cutpoint
  # ----------------------------
  subtype_tfx_cut <- median(sub_df$median_TFx, na.rm = TRUE)

  sub_df <- sub_df %>%
    mutate(
      median_TFx_group_subtype = ifelse(
        median_TFx >= subtype_tfx_cut,
        "High median TFx",
        "Low median TFx"
      ),
      median_TFx_group_subtype = factor(
        median_TFx_group_subtype,
        levels = c("Low median TFx", "High median TFx")
      )
    )

  cat("Subtype-specific median TFx cutpoint:",
      round(subtype_tfx_cut, 4), "%\n")

  cat("TFx group counts:\n")
  print(table(sub_df$median_TFx_group_subtype))

  if (length(unique(sub_df$median_TFx_group_subtype)) < 2) {
    cat("Skipping", subtype, ": only one TFx group present.\n")

    summary_list[[subtype]] <- data.frame(
      receptor_subtype = subtype,
      status = "Skipped: only one TFx group",
      n_patients = n_sub,
      n_events_deaths = n_events,
      n_censored = n_censored,
      TFx_cutpoint = subtype_tfx_cut,

      low_n = sum(sub_df$median_TFx_group_subtype == "Low median TFx"),
      low_events_deaths = sum(
        sub_df$median_TFx_group_subtype == "Low median TFx" &
          sub_df$Event == 1
      ),
      low_median_OS_months = NA_real_,
      low_median_OS_lower_95CI = NA_real_,
      low_median_OS_upper_95CI = NA_real_,

      high_n = sum(sub_df$median_TFx_group_subtype == "High median TFx"),
      high_events_deaths = sum(
        sub_df$median_TFx_group_subtype == "High median TFx" &
          sub_df$Event == 1
      ),
      high_median_OS_months = NA_real_,
      high_median_OS_lower_95CI = NA_real_,
      high_median_OS_upper_95CI = NA_real_,

      logrank_chi_square = NA_real_,
      logrank_p_value = NA_real_
    )

    next
  }

  # ----------------------------
  # Survival fit
  # ----------------------------
  fit <- survfit(
    Surv(OS_months, Event) ~ median_TFx_group_subtype,
    data = sub_df
  )

  # ----------------------------
  # Median OS months by TFx group
  # ----------------------------
  median_tbl <- survminer::surv_median(fit) %>%
    mutate(
      group_clean = case_when(
        str_detect(strata, "Low median TFx") ~ "Low median TFx",
        str_detect(strata, "High median TFx") ~ "High median TFx",
        TRUE ~ strata
      )
    )

  low_median_months <- get_median_value(median_tbl, "Low median TFx", median)
  low_median_lower_95CI <- get_median_value(median_tbl, "Low median TFx", lower)
  low_median_upper_95CI <- get_median_value(median_tbl, "Low median TFx", upper)

  high_median_months <- get_median_value(median_tbl, "High median TFx", median)
  high_median_lower_95CI <- get_median_value(median_tbl, "High median TFx", lower)
  high_median_upper_95CI <- get_median_value(median_tbl, "High median TFx", upper)

  cat("\nMedian OS months by TFx group:\n")
  print(median_tbl)

  # ----------------------------
  # Log-rank p-value
  # ----------------------------
  lr <- survdiff(
    Surv(OS_months, Event) ~ median_TFx_group_subtype,
    data = sub_df
  )

  p_val <- 1 - pchisq(lr$chisq, df = length(lr$n) - 1)
  p_label <- format_p(p_val)

  annot_text <- paste0(
    "Log-rank ", p_label, "\n",
    "Median TFx cutpoint = ", round(subtype_tfx_cut, 2), "%"
  )

  cat("\nLog-rank chi-square:", lr$chisq, "\n")
  cat("Log-rank p-value:", p_val, "\n")

  # ----------------------------
  # Legend labels
  # ----------------------------
  low_n <- sum(sub_df$median_TFx_group_subtype == "Low median TFx")
  low_events <- sum(
    sub_df$median_TFx_group_subtype == "Low median TFx" &
      sub_df$Event == 1
  )

  high_n <- sum(sub_df$median_TFx_group_subtype == "High median TFx")
  high_events <- sum(
    sub_df$median_TFx_group_subtype == "High median TFx" &
      sub_df$Event == 1
  )

  legend_labs <- c(
    paste0("Low median TFx (n=", low_n, ", deaths=", low_events, ")"),
    paste0("High median TFx (n=", high_n, ", deaths=", high_events, ")")
  )

  # ----------------------------
  # Dynamic x-axis for each subgroup
  # ----------------------------
  max_month <- max(sub_df$OS_months, na.rm = TRUE)

  x_max <- ceiling(max_month / 60) * 60

  if (x_max < 60) {
    x_max <- 60
  }

  break_by <- 60

  annot_x <- x_max * 0.96
  annot_y <- 0.97

  cat("\nMax OS month:", max_month, "\n")
  cat("x-axis max:", x_max, "\n")
  cat("x-axis interval:", break_by, "months\n")

  # ----------------------------
  # Plot
  # ----------------------------
  p <- ggsurvplot(
    fit,
    data = sub_df,

    # Main KM curve
    conf.int = TRUE,
    conf.int.alpha = 0.22,
    censor = TRUE,
    censor.shape = 3,
    censor.size = 3.2,
    size = 1.15,

    # Single bottom number-at-risk table
    risk.table = TRUE,
    risk.table.title = "Number at risk",
    risk.table.height = 0.24,
    risk.table.y.text = TRUE,
    risk.table.y.text.col = TRUE,
    tables.theme = theme_cleantable(base_size = 12),

    # Labels
    title = paste0("Overall survival by median TFx: ", subtype),
    xlab = "Time from primary diagnosis (months)",
    ylab = "Overall survival probability",

    # Axis
    break.time.by = break_by,
    xlim = c(0, x_max),
    ylim = c(0, 1.05),

    # Legend
    legend.title = "Median TFx group",
    legend.labs = legend_labs,
    legend = "top",

    # Colors
    palette = c("#1E88E5", "#E74C3C"),

    # Manual p-value annotation
    pval = FALSE,

    # Locked style
    ggtheme = theme_classic(base_size = 15)
  )

  # ----------------------------
  # Clean main KM plot
  # ----------------------------
  p$plot <- p$plot +
    annotate(
      "label",
      x = annot_x,
      y = annot_y,
      label = annot_text,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 4.4,
      label.size = 0.25,
      fill = "white",
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold",
        size = 18,
        margin = margin(t = 10, b = 18)
      ),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.box.margin = margin(b = 8),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),

      # Locked style: no grid lines
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

      plot.margin = margin(t = 18, r = 15, b = 5, l = 15)
    )

  # ----------------------------
  # Clean bottom number-at-risk table
  # ----------------------------
  p$table <- p$table +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),

      # Locked style: no grid lines
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

      plot.margin = margin(t = 4, r = 15, b = 8, l = 15)
    )

  # ----------------------------
  # Save plot
  # ----------------------------
  subtype_file <- safe_name(subtype)

  out_png <- file.path(
    out_dir,
    paste0("OS_KM_median_TFx_", subtype_file, "_months_with_risktable.png")
  )

  out_pdf <- file.path(
    out_dir,
    paste0("OS_KM_median_TFx_", subtype_file, "_months_with_risktable.pdf")
  )

  png(
    filename = out_png,
    width = 12.5,
    height = 8.3,
    units = "in",
    res = 300
  )
  print(p)
  dev.off()

  pdf(
    file = out_pdf,
    width = 12.5,
    height = 8.3
  )
  print(p)
  dev.off()

  cat("\nSaved OS KM plot:\n")
  cat(out_png, "\n")
  cat(out_pdf, "\n")

  # ----------------------------
  # Store summary
  # ----------------------------
  summary_list[[subtype]] <- data.frame(
    receptor_subtype = subtype,
    status = "Plotted",
    n_patients = n_sub,
    n_events_deaths = n_events,
    n_censored = n_censored,
    TFx_cutpoint = subtype_tfx_cut,

    low_n = low_n,
    low_events_deaths = low_events,
    low_median_OS_months = low_median_months,
    low_median_OS_lower_95CI = low_median_lower_95CI,
    low_median_OS_upper_95CI = low_median_upper_95CI,

    high_n = high_n,
    high_events_deaths = high_events,
    high_median_OS_months = high_median_months,
    high_median_OS_lower_95CI = high_median_lower_95CI,
    high_median_OS_upper_95CI = high_median_upper_95CI,

    logrank_chi_square = lr$chisq,
    logrank_p_value = p_val
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# Save summary across subgroups
# ----------------------------
subgroup_summary <- bind_rows(summary_list)

write_csv(subgroup_summary, summary_out)

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("Saved OS receptor subgroup KM summary:\n")
cat(summary_out, "\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

print(subgroup_summary)
```
